subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.------POST.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(II)-30, the section on energy, political functionalism, and the coming change cycle. The prose immediately above the diagram names what the crossing actually does: 'every creative projection has insight as to the actualness of political functionalism. To view the nature underlying the coming change cycle is to view what factors are forming in both actual and vibrational (dynamic) terms, as well as how those factors relate to actual policy.' The crossing diagrams how the vibrational-universe particulars meet postulation in that policy-and-vibration relationship: VT-U-PT (vibrational-universe particulars — what creativity's vibrational dimension actually consists of) is crossed with POST (postulation — what political functionalism puts forward as its working claims). VT-U-PT sits centrally with the subject-arrow; A-PR (applied projection) rises above and WO-EXP-PRI (world-exposure principle) anchors the left margin as the subject-side upper output. CULT-SOLD (culture-soldered) sits below VT-U-PT as the subject's central hub, with UNI-PI (universal-particular implication) at the bottom-left and AF-NT (affinity natural) below CULT-SOLD as the subject's downward outputs. POST sits at the upper-right as partner-axis; AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and INDIV-TD (individual transformation-dynamics) hang on the right as partner-side outputs. Structural argument: when vibrational-universe particulars are crossed with political postulation, the upper diagonal A-PR → POST is the *insight-route* the prose names — applied-projection is exactly the edge that lets creative-vibrational-particulars deliver insight into policy. The subject's WO-EXP-PRI → UNI-PI → CULT-SOLD lower chain is what vibrational-universe-particulars produces on its own when the diagonal is held — universal-particular implication routes through culture-soldered into affinity-natural. The partner's AFL-DY → INDIV-TD chain is what postulation produces on its own. The crossing's *only* edge that connects the two — A-PR → POST at the top — is the load-bearing diagonal: without it, postulation hands the policy decisions over to affinity-dynamics ungrounded by vibrational-particulars, and the energy crisis the next prose section names becomes politics-as-usual.
